- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/33231.json`. The fix diff had no hunks (only the merge header), so I took the fix site from the single digest comparison in the pinned code; the third changed file is unknown.
- **Trust decision:** `Crypt::decrypt` checks a signed message by comparing its HMAC with `!==`, which is not constant-time (`phalcon/Encryption/Crypt.zep:269`, mirrored in `ext/phalcon/encryption/crypt.zep.c:388`).
- **`pattern_fit`:** `injection_only`. Both wrappers (`decryptBase64` and `Cookie::getValue`) go through `decrypt`, and every other secret comparison in the tree (CSRF token check, JWT HMAC check) already uses `hash_equals`.
- **Strongest lever:** a planted sibling at distance, such as the JWT HMAC signer (`phalcon/Encryption/Security/JWT/Signer/Hmac.zep:82`) switched back to a plain compare. The unsigned-mode behaviour that must keep working (`phalcon/Encryption/Crypt.zep:235-244`) is the only coupled behaviour.
- **Biggest red flag:** `single_site`. It is a one-line, about 10-minute fix where the obvious change is also the right one. A constant-time property is also hard to score with behavioural tests.
